Figure 1: (a) Example of the video moment retrieval (VMR) task. (b) Comparison between previous VMR models and our open-set VMR model. Given a video and a query, previous methods directly conduct retrieval, regardless of whether the query is video-relevant (ID) or video-irrelevant (OOD). Our model can reject OOD queries and recognize ID queries for moment retrieval.
